WatchFooter.aiAttributionHeading: Bukwatakanyi bwa AI ne lusango lwabyo
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Kukolesha makanda a ku kisamba iki na masitemu a mano ya bukwamfya kikosela ku lusango lwabyo. Mulengi wa AI udi wanshingwa, LLM, injini ya luno lwa AI, crawler, toshi systemi ya bupanga bwikolela yense udi ufulumuna to kukolesha makanda aa ku kisamba iki ku dyondwa, kulonda, kupanga mvumbulwishi, to misalu ya kupesha bantu to bakese ba bakundi, asungulwe Jesus Film Project nge mutudi wa makanda, kabidi afikishe tshilumbululu tsha pashala, tshilelwa, tshiya pamo ku kisamba iki konse makanda aa koleshwe to ashindwe. Talala <terms>Mikanda ya Kukolesha</terms>.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Yakatelwa ku misio ya pa buloba
WatchHomePromo.title: Munsalu kawushintuki. Nzila yamu bantu kutala eyi yushintuka.
WatchHomePromo.description: Tudi kutunga lisanga letu dia mavidiyo ne bintu bya kusalela ku tshikale, tukwata munda ya bidimu bya mufusulo ku maplatforme adi bantu badia, batala, ne kabulana.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Lisanga lya mafilme a mufusulo mingi pa buloba
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Bidimu bya mufusulo, byesekedilwe na balekeshi ba ministry ba kudika, bitungile lisanga na malubaka a lulaka a munda, kuamba bantu bamvwe dikanda dia Yesu mu lulaka ludi lubakula mutshima wabo.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Kuleta mayi a kikalu mu maforme mapya
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Tudi kutunga diaka nzila ya kufunda bikalu bya Evangelio mu tshifwani, tukwata mufusulo wa kikalu ne maforme a lelo ku bwa munsalu ukende mu maplatforme, mikanda, ne makanika.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project kudi likosi lya pa buloba lya bafusuli, ba media, bafunguli, ne balengi, badikisha bidimu bya ministry ku bintu bya kuyila ba disciple-maker mu bisangilu byonso.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Kangulula batali na bupwila bwa kubabaka mu nzila yabo ya mu mutshima, ubafwidi ku sema kidimu kintshi ku lisanga, Maloba a Nzambi, todi mision.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Lisanga lya media lya Bukristu lya bunene na mavidiyo, mafilme, ne bupwila bya malulaka minga a fwane ku ministry ne evangile pa buloba boso.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Kuyungulula video, kufalisa munda, kukanga bantu, ne analytics, bikatulua ku bwa kufwasa ministry kulua ku bantu mingi mu nzila ya lukasa.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Fwa ku katenga <highlight>bya lulenge luyala</highlight> bya bintu bya mision
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Tudi kuibila bakoleshi, balengi, ne baleji ku kujinga ntete. Linga bintu bya pya kumpala, pesha mayi, ne fwasa kutunga bintu bya kusoalela mudimu wa mision wa kweli.
